label: prf:tmli-constituent-composite-agreement
title: Proof that constituent and composite traces agree
html:
Proof. The hadron \mathfrak{H} \hookrightarrow V^{\otimes 2(j_1 + \cdots + j_n)} embeds into a tensor power of V via the PawLei basis (knot factorization). The braid word \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} \in B_N (where N = 2(j_1 + \cdots + j_n)) acts on V^{\otimes N} through the Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_N(q).

At the constituent level, the crossings between K_i and K_j are grouped by generator index, and the Markov trace factors as \prod \hat{V}_i^{\mathrm{const}} (Markov trace product).

At the composite level, the same braid word \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} has a unique Hecke reduction in H_N(q), and the Markov trace yields P_{K_{\mathfrak{H}}}(q) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_{\mathfrak{H}})).

These are equal because the Markov trace product formula is an exact algebraic identity in H_N(q): the product \prod \hat{V}_i and the direct trace \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_{\mathfrak{H}})) evaluate the same element of H_N(q). The factorization is not an approximation --- it is a rewriting of the trace using the Markov property. \square
